verses.original: Παῦλος δοῦλος Θεοῦ ἀπόστολος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πίστιν ἐκλεκτῶν Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας τῆς κατ’ εὐσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: Paulos doulos Theou apostolos de Iēsou Christou kata pistin eklektōn Theou kai epignōsin alētheias tēs kat’ eusebeian
verses.literal: Paul a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness
verses.literalPt: PAULO, servo de Deus, e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, segundo a fé dos eleitos de Deus, e o conhecimento da verdade, que é segundo a piedade,

verses.original: ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἣν ἐπηγγείλατο ὁ ἀψευδὴς Θεὸς πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων
verses.transliteration: ep’ elpidi zōēs aiōniou hēn epēngeilato ho apseudēs Theos pro chronōn aiōniōn
verses.literal: in the hope of eternal life which God who cannot lie promised before time began
verses.literalPt: Em esperança da vida eterna, a qual Deus, que não pode mentir, prometeu antes dos tempos dos séculos;

verses.original: ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ καιροῖς ἰδίοις τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐν κηρύγματι ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγὼ κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ephanerōsen de kairois idiois ton logon autou en kērygmati ho episteuthēn egō kat’ epitagēn tou Sōtēros hēmōn Theou
verses.literal: In His own time He has made . . . His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior
verses.literalPt: Mas a seu tempo manifestou a sua palavra pela pregação que me foi confiada segundo o mandamento de Deus, nosso Salvador;

verses.original: Τίτῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ κατὰ κοινὴν πίστιν Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Titō gnēsiō teknō kata koinēn pistin Charis kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros kai Christou Iēsou tou Sōtēros hēmōn
verses.literal: To Titus my true child in our common faith Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior
verses.literalPt: A Tito, meu verdadeiro filho, segundo a fé comum: Graça, misericórdia, e paz da parte de Deus Pai, e da do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nosso Salvador.

verses.original: Τούτου χάριν ἀπέλιπόν σε ἐν Κρήτῃ ἵνα τὰ λείποντα ἐπιδιορθώσῃ καὶ καταστήσῃς κατὰ πόλιν πρεσβυτέρους ὡς ἐγώ σοι διεταξάμην
verses.transliteration: Toutou charin apelipon se en Krētē hina ta leiponta epidiorthōsē kai katastēsēs kata polin presbyterous hōs egō soi dietaxamēn
verses.literal: The reason . . . I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town as I directed you
verses.literalPt: Por esta causa te deixei em Creta, para que pusesses em boa ordem as coisas que ainda restam, e de cidade em cidade estabelecesses presbíteros, como já te mandei:

verses.original: εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἀνέγκλητος μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἀνήρ τέκνα ἔχων πιστά μὴ ἐν κατηγορίᾳ ἀσωτίας ἢ ἀνυπότακτα
verses.transliteration: ei tis estin anenklētos mias gynaikos anēr tekna echōn pista mē en katēgoria asōtias ē anypotakta
verses.literal: An elder must . . . be blameless the husband of but one wife having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination
verses.literalPt: Aquele que for irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, que tenha filhos fiéis, que não possam ser acusados de dissolução nem são desobedientes.

verses.original: Δεῖ γὰρ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνέγκλητον εἶναι ὡς Θεοῦ οἰκονόμον μὴ αὐθάδη μὴ ὀργίλον μὴ πάροινον μὴ πλήκτην μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ
verses.transliteration: Dei gar ton episkopon anenklēton einai hōs Theou oikonomon mē authadē mē orgilon mē paroinon mē plēktēn mē aischrokerdē
verses.literal: As God’s steward an overseer must be above reproach not self-willed not quick-tempered not given to drunkenness not violent not greedy for money
verses.literalPt: Porque convém que o bispo seja irrepreensível, como despenseiro da casa de Deus, não soberbo, nem iracundo, nem dado ao vinho, nem espancador, nem cobiçoso de torpe ganância;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ φιλόξενον φιλάγαθον σώφρονα δίκαιον ὅσιον ἐγκρατῆ
verses.transliteration: alla philoxenon philagathon sōphrona dikaion hosion enkratē
verses.literal: Instead he must be hospitable a lover of good self-controlled upright holy and disciplined
verses.literalPt: Mas dado à hospitalidade, amigo do bem, moderado, justo, santo, temperante;

verses.original: ἀντεχόμενον τοῦ κατὰ τὴν διδαχὴν πιστοῦ λόγου ἵνα δυνατὸς ᾖ καὶ παρακαλεῖν ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ καὶ τοὺς ἀντιλέγοντας ἐλέγχειν
verses.transliteration: antechomenon tou kata tēn didachēn pistou logou hina dynatos ē kai parakalein en tē didaskalia tē hygiainousē kai tous antilegontas elenchein
verses.literal: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught so that he can . . . . . . encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it
verses.literalPt: Retendo firme a fiel palavra, que é conforme a doutrina, para que seja poderoso, tanto para admoestar com a sã doutrina, como para convencer os contradizentes.

verses.original: Εἰσὶν γὰρ πολλοὶ καὶ ἀνυπότακτοι ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ τῆς περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: Eisin gar polloi kai anypotaktoi mataiologoi kai phrenapatai malista hoi ek tēs peritomēs
verses.literal: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception especially those of the circumcision
verses.literalPt: Porque há muitos desordenados, faladores, vãos e enganadores, principalmente os da circuncisão,

verses.original: οὓς δεῖ ἐπιστομίζειν οἵτινες ὅλους οἴκους ἀνατρέπουσιν διδάσκοντες ἃ μὴ δεῖ αἰσχροῦ κέρδους χάριν
verses.transliteration: hous dei epistomizein hoitines holous oikous anatrepousin didaskontes ha mē dei aischrou kerdous charin
verses.literal: who must be silenced For the sake of dishonorable gain they undermine entire households and teach things they should not
verses.literalPt: Aos quais convém tapar a boca; homens que transtornam casas inteiras ensinando o que não convém, por torpe ganância.

verses.original: εἶπέν τις ἐξ αὐτῶν ἴδιος αὐτῶν προφήτης Κρῆτες ἀεὶ ψεῦσται κακὰ θηρία γαστέρες ἀργαί
verses.transliteration: eipen tis ex autōn idios autōn prophētēs Krētes aei pseustai kaka thēria gasteres argai
verses.literal: As one of their own prophets has said Cretans are always liars evil beasts lazy gluttons
verses.literalPt: Um deles, seu próprio profeta, disse: Os cretenses são sempre mentirosos, bestas ruins, ventres preguiçosos.

verses.original: Ἡ μαρτυρία αὕτη ἐστὶν ἀληθής δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἔλεγχε αὐτοὺς ἀποτόμως ἵνα ὑγιαίνωσιν ἐν τῇ πίστει
verses.transliteration: Hē martyria hautē estin alēthēs di’ hēn aitian elenche autous apotomōs hina hygiainōsin en tē pistei
verses.literal: This testimony is true Therefore rebuke them sternly so that they will be sound in the faith
verses.literalPt: Este testemunho é verdadeiro. Portanto, repreende-os severamente, para que sejam sãos na fé.

verses.original: μὴ προσέχοντες Ἰουδαϊκοῖς μύθοις καὶ ἐντολαῖς ἀνθρώπων ἀποστρεφομένων τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: mē prosechontes Ioudaikois mythois kai entolais anthrōpōn apostrephomenōn tēn alētheian
verses.literal: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth
verses.literalPt: Não dando ouvidos às fábulas judaicas, nem aos mandamentos de homens que se desviam da verdade.

verses.original: Πάντα καθαρὰ τοῖς καθαροῖς τοῖς δὲ μεμιαμμένοις καὶ ἀπίστοις οὐδὲν καθαρόν ἀλλὰ μεμίανται αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ συνείδησις
verses.transliteration: Panta kathara tois katharois tois de memiammenois kai apistois ouden katharon alla memiantai autōn kai ho nous kai hē syneidēsis
verses.literal: To the pure all things are pure but to the defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure Indeed both their minds and their consciences are defiled
verses.literalPt: Todas as coisas são puras para os puros, mas nada é puro para os contaminados e infiéis; antes o seu entendimento e consciência estão contaminados.

verses.original: Θεὸν ὁμολογοῦσιν εἰδέναι τοῖς δὲ ἔργοις ἀρνοῦνται βδελυκτοὶ ὄντες καὶ ἀπειθεῖς καὶ πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἀδόκιμοι
verses.transliteration: Theon homologousin eidenai tois de ergois arnountai bdelyktoi ontes kai apeitheis kai pros pan ergon agathon adokimoi
verses.literal: They profess to know God but by their actions they deny Him They are detestable disobedient and unfit for any good deed
verses.literalPt: Confessam que conhecem a Deus, mas negam-no com as obras, sendo abomináveis, e desobedientes, e reprovados para toda a boa obra.
